tables.name: world
tables.comment:
TechEmpower `World(id, randomNumber)`. The DDL is generated by
`jwc migrate new init`; the 10,000-row seed is the hand-written
`migrations/0001_init.data.sql` sidecar, which `migrate up` applies in the
data phase of that migration.

The physical column is lower-case `randomnumber`, unquoted, because the
other stacks' hand-written SQL (`UPDATE world SET randomnumber = $1`)
refers to it that way and they all share this one table. The JWC-side
name stays `randomNumber` so the JSON matches the TechEmpower shape.
